https://brosfourrspeed.com/parts-%26-merchandise/ols/products/3rd-gen-tacoma-grill

***
I finally get rid of the chrome grill on my TRD Offroad and replace it with a direct insert from Bullet Proof Fabricating.  This was a very simple install and took about 45 minutes.  The letters on the grill are bolt on and can be changed which cover the nice powered coated mesh.  I like that this is a very unique grill that I won't see on many other trucks, even though it does look similar to the factory TRD Pro grill, it has it's own uniqueness.  Be sure to check out a similar grill for the second generation tacoma down below!
